articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude 4, featuring a breakthrough 2 million token context window and enhanced multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates significant improvements on complex coding and scientific benchmarks, outperforming previous state-of-the-art systems. The release includes a new 'deep think' mode that allows the model to deliberate for extended periods before producing output.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product into Operator Pro, a fully autonomous agent platform designed to handle end-to-end enterprise workflows including procurement, HR onboarding, and financial reporting. The platform integrates natively with Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft 365 ecosystems. Early enterprise customers report up to 60% reduction in manual processing time for routine administrative tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Human-Level Performance on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 has surpassed human-expert performance on USMLE, MRCPUK, and several other international medical licensing examinations. The model was evaluated under strict proctored conditions to ensure validity of results. Researchers caution that benchmark performance does not directly translate to clinical deployment readiness, and regulatory review remains essential.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Division Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over Llama Model Transparency
articles.summary: The European Union's newly established AI Act Enforcement Division levied a €230 million fine against Meta for insufficient transparency disclosures surrounding its open-source Llama model family. Regulators argued that Meta's documentation failed to adequately disclose training data sources and potential biases as required for high-risk system classifications. Meta has announced it will appeal the decision while simultaneously updating its model documentation practices.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Powered Copilot Directly into Azure SQL and Fabric Platforms
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced deep native integration of retrieval-augmented generation capabilities into Azure SQL Database and Microsoft Fabric, allowing enterprises to query structured and unstructured data simultaneously through natural language. The system automatically indexes documents, tables, and data lakes into a unified vector store without requiring external tooling. The feature enters public preview this week and is expected to reach general availability by Q3 2026.

articles.title: Runway Debuts Gen-4 Turbo: Real-Time Video Generation at 4K Resolution
articles.summary: Runway has launched Gen-4 Turbo, a video generation model capable of producing 4K resolution clips in near real-time on consumer-grade GPUs. The model introduces new cinematic consistency controls that maintain character identity and scene coherence across extended sequences. Hollywood studios including Lionsgate and A24 have signed partnership agreements to explore production pipeline integration.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Rapid Proliferation of Unvetted AI Agents in Critical Infrastructure
articles.summary: A comprehensive report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute has flagged growing risks associated with the deployment of autonomous AI agents in power grids, water treatment facilities, and financial clearing systems. Researchers documented over 340 instances in the past year where agentic systems made consequential decisions without adequate human oversight. The report calls for an international framework governing agent deployment in safety-critical domains before further scaling.

articles.title: Mistral Releases Mistral Edge 3B: A Compact Model Optimized for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has released Mistral Edge 3B, a 3-billion parameter model specifically tuned for on-device deployment on smartphones and embedded systems. The model runs efficiently on Apple Neural Engine and Qualcomm Snapdragon NPU hardware without requiring cloud connectivity. Benchmarks show competitive performance with models twice its size on instruction-following and summarization tasks, making it a strong candidate for privacy-sensitive applications.
